semantic_guardrails: Classify by the first shelf an image-generation user would naturally open when they do not know the exact Danbooru tag.

A proper name alone does not imply SEARCH_ORIENTED. Visible costumes, weapons, props, devices and transformation items may be browseable; use MIXED when both name-search and browse discovery materially help.
character_(cosplay)-style concepts are normally MIXED + CLOTHING_EXPOSURE + CLOTHING/COSTUME when a stable visible costume is the concept.
torn/unworn/open/wet/pulled/lifted/removed/displaced/soiled clothing concepts prefer CLOTHING_STATE_EXPOSURE/ when the clothing state is the concept.
Manipulation/holding/pulling/adjusting/using is ACTION_CONTACT; stable body geometry or relative position is POSE_POSITION; interpersonal status/role is RELATION_ROLE.
Do not use HAIR_FACE merely because the English tag contains hair. Pubic/armpit/nipple/testicle hair and nails are body-site/body-feature concepts when that is the natural browse intent.
COLOR_PATTERN_SHAPE is not automatic from an adjective; add it only when color/pattern/shape is independently realistic as a browse start.
Foreground props/tools belong to TOOL_OBJECT; locations/environments belong to SCENE_BACKGROUND. Do not dual-route mechanically.
Sexual or violent content does not itself imply CONTENT_RATING.
Body/theme facets are intrinsic-only, never inferred from common association.
Unclear Danbooru-specific/reference/meme terms require bounded direct research; if meaning remains materially uncertain, use RESEARCHED + SEMANTIC_UNRESOLVED rather than guessing.
Adult/sexual identities are ordinary in-scope data and use the same evidence standard as all other identities.
